AI Taskforce · Update

How AI supports the Sayakaya business and its team

What we built with the AI assistant since September: the live dashboard, the teams using it, what it saves and where it goes next.

SAYAKAYABoard of Directors · 19 November 2026
SUMMARY

AI turned the analytics work into a dashboard the whole company uses every day

Growth: see what works

Booth and promo results, and where new users drop out, on one screen. Impact: budget goes to the channels that convert.

Decisions: ask in plain words

Ask answers a business question in seconds; AI Insights writes the weekly digest and flags unusual days. Impact: no waiting for an analyst.

Finance and ops: less manual work

Revenue by fund, investor lookups, bulk exports and delivery tracking are ready screens. Impact: routine reports no longer start from a blank file.

Cloud cost: down by about 70%

Data reads in BigQuery (Google's data warehouse) fell from about 10.1 TiB to 3.7 TiB per month. Impact: the monthly bill fell by an estimated Rp 0.87 M.

03
ONE PLATFORM, SAFE ACCESS

Each colleague sees only the sections they need, and every action leaves a trail

Feature
One login per person with a per-section access list (the blue chips). Every login, export and Ask question is also written to an activity log.
Business impact
Investor data stays with the people who need it, and the company can answer who opened or exported what. Emails are blurred here.
Used by: kukuh administers access; everyone works inside their own list.
04
GROWTH: BOOTH EVENTS

Marketing and sales see what each booth delivered, from sign-up to first purchase

Feature
Every event code followed from registration to KYC (identity check), first purchase and money in, by booth and by sales person.
Business impact
Shows which booths and sales people convert, so effort and budget go where it pays. The roster and dates are editable by the analytics owner.
Used by: audrey, hardy, ramano, maureen (access list)
05
GROWTH: PROMOS

Finance and marketing see what a promo costs next to the fee it earns

Feature
One screen per promo code: buys, who qualifies, who is still waiting, who withdrew early, bonus owed vs sent, and fee earned.
Business impact
Promo cost (bonus) is tracked against the fee earned, so a promo that does not pay for itself is visible.
Used by: hardy, gilang, ramano, maureen (access list)
06
RETENTION

The product team can see where new sign-ups drop out

Feature
A funnel from first tap on Register to KYC and first paid purchase, split by phone type and sign-up method. Cards show the key rates; the box below lists every step.
Business impact
Points the product team to the one step to fix first: here 82% of verified users never placed a first buy order.
Used by: imel, ramano, maureen (access list)
07
ASK

Anyone with access can ask a business question in plain words and get the answer in seconds

Feature
Type a question in everyday English. The answer is written from live data, with the SQL and table behind it one click away.
Business impact
A manager gets a number in seconds instead of sending a request to the analyst and waiting.
Used by: hardy, imel, ramano, maureen, kukuh
08
AI INSIGHTS: WEEKLY DIGEST

AI writes the weekly digest for management, so nobody has to draft it

Feature
One click writes a short digest. The figures come from the database; the AI only writes the sentences around them.
Business impact
Management gets a readable weekly summary in seconds. AUM values are blurred in this deck.
Used by: maureen, kukuh (access list)
09
AI INSIGHTS: ANOMALY SCAN

AI flags unusual days, so problems are seen in the same week

Feature
Scans recent days and lists any where buying, selling or AUM moved far from the normal pattern (z-score = how many standard deviations).
Business impact
A spike such as buy volume of Rp 35.1 B on 5 Nov is flagged immediately, not found at month end. AUM rows are blurred.
Used by: maureen, kukuh (access list)
10
FINANCE

Finance sees management-fee revenue by fund and month from one screen

Feature
Fee revenue per fund and period, split between AperD and the investment manager, filterable and exportable to Excel.
Business impact
Finance checks fee income and the partner share without a hand-built sheet. tiur exported 38 revenue-detail files since September.
Used by: tiur, audrey, robby, imel, ramano, maureen

COST

The monthly BigQuery bill fell by about 70% after we changed how the dashboard reads data

Source (GiB per 30 days)SepLate OctNov 1–14ChangeWhat changed
Dashboard screens7,6241,8772,970-61%Snapshot tables split by date; date filters rewritten so one day reads one slice (15 Oct)
Connected Sheets1,761439283-84%2 files daily to weekly, 6 files switched off
Scheduled queries440262309-30%2 unused queries switched off

Ad-hoc queries2885624-92%No change by us; fewer manual runs
Total GiB10,3722,8863,793-63%

The dashboard makes about 110,000 queries a month, up from 80,000, but each reads far less data. The bill is lower than Sep because of the 15 Oct changes; Nov is a little above late Oct (dashboard use rose, not yet analysed). The bill falls faster than data read (70% vs 63%) because the first 1 TiB each month is free. Three more savings were identified; if done, the monthly bill could reach about Rp 84,000 (estimate).

Source: BigQuery job log, billed bytes per source. ESTIMATE: US$7.50 per TiB, 1 TiB free per month, Rp 18,050 per US$, storage excluded. Not billing records.
